description: Type text into a field. Pass the field's ref to focus it first; omit ref to type into whatever already has focus. Set clear to replace the existing text and submit to press Enter afterwards. Given a dropdown's ref, chooses the option with that text.

ref.description: Field ref from browser_snapshot, e.g. e123.

tabId.description: Tab id from browser_open_tab or browser_list_tabs.

name: browser_type
